name: system.connection
label: Connection
description: Connection information for reaching an external service endpoint (e.g. an LLM). Holds the server URL, API key, and request timeout. Referenced by other models such as olio.llm.chatConfig.

fields.name: requestTimeout
fields.description: Hard timeout in seconds for connections. Used with CompletableFuture.orTimeout() to abort hung requests. 0 = no timeout.

fields.name: dialect
fields.description: Wire dialect (protocol) of this endpoint: OLLAMA (/api/chat), OPENAI (Azure /openai/deployments/...), or OPENAI_COMPAT (/v1/chat/completions, e.g. LiteLLM). ADDITIVE (Phase B2) and NOT yet authoritative for protocol selection — olio.llm.chatConfig.serviceType still drives resolution this phase. Not named 'provider' because that is a reserved field-schema keyword already bound to EncryptFieldProvider on apiKey.
